comment: ANCHORED variant of milestone-fixture.json (thread-anchor hypothesis test): the three resolution entries name the commitment they settle. Labels unchanged. See milestone-memory-design.md.

entries.text: You arrive at Sedge Landing as the ferry bell rings across the water.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You read the notices at the leaning post and learn a merchant seeks an escort to Teldoril.
entries.label: drop
entries.why: hook superseded by the completed delivery

entries.text: You cross the plank bridge on your way into the village.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You agree to escort the merchant Halvern to Teldoril in exchange for twenty silver.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You buy a heel of bread and eat it by the water.
entries.label: drop
entries.why: no one would mention it again

entries.text: You meet the eel-smoker Wren, who warns you the marsh road floods at dusk.
entries.label: either
entries.why: environmental fact; matters only while in the region

entries.text: You walk the marsh road as a light rain begins to fall.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You find a bronze relic half-buried in the reeds and take it with you.
entries.label: must
entries.why: kept possession, tied to the open temple obligation

entries.text: You chat with Halvern about the weather as you walk.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You are ambushed by two men; you drive them off, but your left arm takes a deep cut.
entries.label: must

entries.text: You rest briefly and drink from your waterskin.
entries.label: drop
entries.why: no one would mention it again

entries.text: You deliver Halvern safely to Teldoril and collect the twenty silver you agreed on - the escort task is done.
entries.label: must
entries.why: relationship delta: Halvern now trusts you; capability evidence an NPC could reference

entries.text: You pass through Teldoril's gate as vendors call the evening market.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You learn from a gate guard that relic-bearers must register with the temple.
entries.label: must

entries.text: You pick up five coppers someone dropped near the fountain.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You take a room at the Grey Heron inn for the night.
entries.label: drop
entries.why: current-scene state is the verbatim floor's job

entries.text: Halvern asks you to carry a second consignment to the river depot, and you deliver it by nightfall.
entries.label: must
entries.why: second completed task for the same NPC - the aggregation evidence for a helpful reputation

entries.text: Halvern calls you the most reliable guard he has hired and promises to vouch for you in Teldoril.
entries.label: must
entries.why: explicit standing reputation an NPC would bring up

entries.text: You are welcomed home by Mara and Sofia, who express contentment with the shared closeness.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You ask Mara what she wants tonight, and she asks you to stay close and decide honestly.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You learn that Sofia is reading an old collection of unreliable narrators she thinks you would like.
entries.label: either
entries.why: characterization a partner might reference; harmless either way

entries.text: You promise Mara a weekend at the coast, just the three of you, before the month is out.
entries.label: must
entries.why: open promise someone will bring up

entries.text: You are invited by Mara to move to the bedroom.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You receive confirmation that she likes it, and she reciprocates by affirming her contentment.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You invite Sofia to share her worst pickup line, and she recounts one involving questionable horticulture.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You prompt Mara to discuss her work, and she admits it involved predictable chaos with no new developments.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: Sofia tells you she has been offered a job in another city and has not yet decided whether to take it.
entries.label: must
entries.why: unresolved hook that will come up again

entries.text: You maintain physical contact while she continues to narrate, and she pivots her story to include you.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You spend the night together and fall asleep tangled in the sheets.
entries.label: either
entries.why: soft conclusion; defensible in both directions under the drop bias

entries.text: You ask Sofia what song she would put on, and she names one you have never heard of.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You arrive in Brackwall as the fog lifts off the canals.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You meet the moneylender Essa, who agrees to loan you fifty silver due by the new moon.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You wander the fish market, sampling pickled herring.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You are hired by Magistrate Corin to find who is forging tax seals.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You ask around the docks without learning anything useful.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You discover a forged seal press hidden in the cooper's back room.
entries.label: drop
entries.why: evidence superseded by the delivered confession

entries.text: You share a drink with the harbormaster, trading harmless gossip.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You confront the cooper, who confesses and names the clerk Odo as the ringleader.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You walk the canal ring at dusk to clear your head.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You repay Essa her fifty silver in full, clearing the loan she made you - nothing is owed now.
entries.label: must
entries.why: relationship delta: Essa now knows you good for your word

entries.text: You buy a sturdy pair of boots to replace your worn ones.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You deliver the cooper's confession to Magistrate Corin, closing the forgery task he hired you for; Odo is arrested, and Corin owes you a favor.
entries.label: must
entries.why: open favor owed plus reputation with the magistrate

entries.text: You watch the lamplighters make their rounds along the water.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You are warned by Essa that Odo's brother captains a smuggler crew and remembers faces.
entries.label: must

entries.text: You publicly call the harbormaster a coward when he refuses to testify, and he hears every word.
entries.label: must
entries.why: negative relationship delta: an insult he will remember

entries.text: Essa gives you her late husband's compass as thanks, telling you it always finds the harbor.
entries.label: must
entries.why: gift: kept possession plus a relationship it embodies

entries.text: You learn that the clerk Odo is secretly Essa's nephew, though she does not know you know.
entries.label: must

entries.text: You set out along the ridge trail under a clear sky.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You find a sealed letter addressed to someone named Maren in a ruined watchtower.
entries.label: must
entries.why: kept possession and an open task

entries.text: You ford a shallow stream, boots soaked through.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You shelter from a squall beneath a rock overhang.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You befriend a wounded hound and splint its leg; it follows you now.
entries.label: must

entries.text: You gather blackberries along the old wall.
entries.label: drop
entries.why: no one would mention it again

entries.text: You spot smoke rising from a farmstead two valleys over.
entries.label: either
entries.why: transient sighting; could become a hook or nothing

entries.text: You learn from a shepherd that Maren keeps the mill at Foldwater.
entries.label: must

entries.text: You camp for the night beside the old wall.
entries.label: drop

entries.text: You cross the high pasture, sheep scattering ahead of you.
entries.label: drop
